title: RFC005 Checkpoint Ancestry Manifest (§35.1/§11, plan spec-checkpoint-ancestry-c6)
$comment: Closed envelope, v1.1. document_kind 'base' is the generation-0 manifest checkpoint_ancestry.py.freeze_checkpoint_ancestry.py writes before any checkpoint exists; document_kind 'checkpoint' is that same document extended by extend_for_checkpoint/finalize_checkpoint_document once a concrete .pt exists, and carries the non-null 'checkpoint' object. checkpoint_rights_status/checkpoint_privacy_status are DERIVED (checkpoint_ancestry.derive_rights_status/derive_privacy_status) from base_model_decision and dataset_exposures[].decision -- this schema does not and must not let a caller declare them directly beyond the closed enum. distribution_allowed is DERIVED (DEC-011, checkpoint_ancestry.derive_distribution_allowed): true iff distribution_decision is non-null AND both rights and privacy already derive approved -- never a caller-declared boolean. adapters/merge_history are present as maxItems:0 arrays -- this schema documents that RFC005 v1 checkpoints have no adapter/merge ancestry yet, rather than omitting the fields and leaving a future writer to guess the shape. parents is maxItems:1 as of 1.1.0 (DEC-028 D1): initialization_kind 'clean_pretrained' still forces parents to [] (maxItems 0 via the conditional below); 'warm_start' requires exactly one parent entry, the S2 discovery checkpoint a S3 run was init-from'd from (checkpoint_ancestry.build_base_ancestry(parent=...)). legacy_ancestry.value is pinned false: this manifest can only be built from an S0 report whose own legacy_ancestry audit already came back False (checkpoint_ancestry.build_base_ancestry refuses otherwise) -- 'true' or 'null' (unaudited) never reach this document. exposure_ledger/transitive_exposure_manifest are closed {kind: not_produced, reason} | {kind: root, root_hash} unions, never a bare array -- v1's builder only ever emits the not_produced branch (RFC005 has no released checkpoint distribution root yet); the root branch exists so a later release can be expressed without a schema break.

initialization_kind.$comment: 1.1.0 (DEC-028 D1): 'clean_pretrained' (parents forced to [] by the conditional below) or 'warm_start' (exactly one parent, weights-only init from a prior discovery checkpoint). A merge or fine-tune-of-fine-tune-of-fine-tune would need a third kind plus non-empty merge_history, which v1.1 does not ship.

distribution_allowed.$comment: DEC-011: derived (checkpoint_ancestry.derive_distribution_allowed), never declared -- true iff distribution_decision is non-null AND rights and privacy both derive approved. This schema does not enforce that derivation; verify_sidecar re-derives and refuses disagreement.

allOf.$comment: DEC-028 D1: clean_pretrained never carries a parent; warm_start always carries exactly one.

pinned_hashes.$comment: Pointer (path + sha256) to the source pinned-hashes file weights_set_sha256/processor_set_sha256 were derived from -- not a duplicated copy of its content.

value.$comment: Pinned false: build_base_ancestry refuses any S0 report whose own legacy_ancestry.value is not False (true or null/unaudited never reach this document).

exposure_state.$comment: Closed union, never a bare array -- a caller passing [] (or any array) fails both branches because each branch requires type object.

parent.$comment: One warm-start parent (DEC-028 D1): the prior checkpoint a S3 run's base ancestry was init-from'd from. checkpoint_id/checkpoint_sha256/run_id/s1_run_manifest_hash/step are taken from the parent's own finalized checkpoint document_kind sidecar; ancestry_hash is that sidecar's own ancestry_hash (the checkpoint document's self-hash, not its base); run_class is taken from the parent's companion S1-format run manifest, never from a caller argument (checkpoint_ancestry.build_base_ancestry).
